counter_explanation_constraint.statement: On this frozen substrate, another static local applicability/state/action feature is not a justified rescue merely because the parent endpoint effect survives. A new branch must change the causal object and make a prospective prediction not expressible by source-target transport, static applicability, earliest-action mediation, or symbolic pre-divergence option overlap.
